notes.title: Super GMA Upcoming Release
notes.notes:
Hello fellow gamers! I hope you all are having a extraordinary day. Today I'd like to announce that Super GMA will be available on August 17, 2018. If you are a fan of fighting or retro style games, you're in for a big surprise. For any questions or more information please email or subscribe to get the latest news and updates. Here are the links to the Twitter and Youtube channel. Have a nice day and take care!

Twitter: https://twitter.com/tech_titan_llc
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCbQEK8Y1GW1tgalOC-OS_Zw
